item.title: The Whistle: Special Bulletin - mTLS bypasses in Traffic Server and Traefik
item.description: A short alert between digests: Traffic Server’s Tuesday release fixes fifteen flaws and two of them hand out the wrong client certificate identity; Traefik patched a second connection-identity bug in the same month on related plumbing; and Red Hat is pulling two roots out of its system CA bundle over the eMudhra key leak. mTLS origins, meet your change window.
